depth.h2: What Hanover Park Homes Need From a Plumber
depth.intro: Hanover Park went from a few hundred people in 1960 to more than 28,000 by 1980. The median home here was built in 1976. When most of a town goes up in the same two decades, its plumbing tends to need the same things at the same time.

tiles.title: 1970s and 80s Homes Showing Their Age
tiles.body: Water heaters, sump pumps, shutoff valves and supply lines from that era are well past the age they were built to last, and many homes have gone through several water heaters by now. A [whole-home checkup](/hanover-park/plumbing-maintenance) tells you what’s close to the end, so you can replace it before it fails.

tiles.title: Storms, Power Outages and Sump Pumps
tiles.body: On August 23, 2007, Hanover Park got 3.25 inches of rain in a short time, followed by widespread power outages. Some basements took on water from sewer backups, others because the sump pump stopped when the power went out. A [sump pump with a battery backup](/hanover-park/sump-pumps) keeps running in a blackout, and a [backflow valve](/hanover-park/flood-control-maintenance) helps keep sewer water out.

tiles.title: Main Line Clogs and Roots
tiles.body: Sewer lines from the 1970s are now about 50 years old, and trees planted with the subdivisions have had decades to grow toward them. When several drains slow down at once, the main line is usually the problem. We [clear the line](/hanover-park/drain-cleaning) and can [camera it](/hanover-park/video-camera-sewer-inspections) to show you what caused it.

tiles.title: Winter Freezes and Burst Pipes
tiles.body: Long cold snaps are hard on pipes in exterior walls, crawl spaces and unheated basements. A split pipe can flood a basement fast once it thaws. We’re on call 24/7 for [burst pipe repair](/hanover-park/burst-pipe-repair), and we can add shutoff valves so you can isolate a problem area next time.

faq.h2: Plumbing Questions From Hanover Park Homeowners

items.q: How much does a plumber cost in Hanover Park?
items.a: It depends on the job. The main factors are what’s wrong, how hard it is to reach, the parts or materials needed and the age of your plumbing. We give you a flat-rate price before any work begins, so you know the cost going in. Give us a call and we’ll walk you through it.

items.q: How fast can you get to my home in an emergency?
items.preview: Call us any time, day or night, including weekends and holidays.
items.a: Call us any time, day or night, including weekends and holidays. Our Greenbrook Boulevard office keeps our plumbers close to Hanover Park, and we [treat emergencies as a priority](/hanover-park/emergency-plumbing). Arrival times depend on the day, but we’ll get a plumber to you as soon as we can.

items.q: Is basement flooding a common problem in Hanover Park?
items.a: It’s a real risk. Heavy storms can overload the sewers, and power outages can stop a sump pump right when you need it. A battery backup and a backflow valve are the two upgrades we recommend most often here.

items.q: Do cold snaps cause burst pipes in Hanover Park homes?
items.preview: They can, especially in homes from the 1970s and 80s with pipes in exterior walls, crawl spaces or unheated basements.
items.a: They can, especially in homes from the 1970s and 80s with pipes in exterior walls, crawl spaces or unheated basements. Keep cabinet doors open on cold nights, disconnect garden hoses in the fall and know where your main shutoff is.

items.q: My drains are all slow at once. What does that mean?
items.preview: When several drains slow down or gurgle at the same time, the clog is usually in the main sewer line, not in one fixture.
items.a: When several drains slow down or gurgle at the same time, the clog is usually in the main sewer line, not in one fixture. We’ll clear it and can run a camera to show you whether roots or a damaged pipe caused it.
